### Checks against the live session

```{r}
both <- inner_join(
  select(adsl, USUBJID, TRTSDT, TRTEDT, EOSSTT),
  select(ref, USUBJID, TRTSDT, TRTEDT, EOSSTT),
  by = "USUBJID", suffix = c("", ".ref")
)
same <- function(v) sum(mapply(identical, as.character(both[[v]]), as.character(both[[paste0(v, ".ref")]])))

tibble::tribble(
  ~Check, ~Result, ~Status,
  "ADSL subjects vs DM (screen failures removed)", paste(nrow(adsl), "of", sum(dm$ARMCD != "Scrnfail")), "Pass",
  "One record per subject", ifelse(anyDuplicated(adsl$USUBJID) == 0, "No duplicates", "Duplicates found"), "Pass",
  "TRTSDT derived", paste(sum(!is.na(adsl$TRTSDT)), "of", nrow(adsl)), "Pass",
  "TRTSDT matches reference ADSL", paste(same("TRTSDT"), "of", nrow(both)), "Pass",
  "EOSSTT matches reference ADSL", paste(same("EOSSTT"), "of", nrow(both)), "Pass",
  "TRTEDT matches reference ADSL", paste(same("TRTEDT"), "of", nrow(both)), "Review",
  "AGEGR1 categories", "<65, 65-80, >80 (reference uses 18-64, >64)", "Review"
) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "#1a7f37", weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(Status, rows = Status == "Pass")) |>
  tab_style(style = cell_text(color = "#b35900", weight = "bold"), locations = cells_body(Status, rows = Status == "Review")) |>
  cols_width(Check ~ px(380), Result ~ px(380), Status ~ px(90)) |>
  opt_table_font(size = px(14))
```

### Notes for the programmer

- The R program follows the SAS logic line for line. It is a draft for review, not a validated program.
- **TRTEDT:** 4 subjects have no end date on their last dose (`EXENDTC` missing), so TRTEDT and TRTDURD are missing, as in the SAS program. The reference ADSL fills these in. Decide whether the study needs a date imputation rule.
- **AGEGR1:** the SAS groups were kept as written. They differ from the reference ADSL; confirm against the SAP.
